The implementation is complete. Here's a summary of what I implemented in `libs/partners/perplexity/langchain_perplexity/chat_models.py`:

## Module-level functions

- **`_use_responses_api(payload)`** — returns `True` when the payload has a built-in tool (`type != "function"`, via `_is_builtin_tool`) or any of the Responses-only keys `previous_response_id`, `instructions`, `input`, `include`; `False` for function-only/no tools.
- **`_convert_responses_usage(usage)`** — returns `None` when all token fields are absent; derives `total_tokens` from `input_tokens + output_tokens` when missing. Handles mappings, pydantic models, and plain objects (via a `_get_attr` helper).
- **`_convert_responses_to_chat_result(response)`** — extracts content from `output_text` (falling back to concatenating `output_text` parts of message items), attaches `usage_metadata`, and puts Perplexity extras (citations/images/related_questions, search & fetch-URL results) in `additional_kwargs`, plus `model_name`/`status`/`id` in `response_metadata`.
- **`_convert_responses_stream_event_to_chunk(event)`** — handles `response.output_text.delta` (content chunk), `response.completed` (usage + extras + generation_info), returns `None` for unrelated events, and raises `PerplexityResponsesStreamError` for `response.error` / `response.failed`.
- **`PerplexityResponsesStreamError`** — structured exception with `event_type`, `message`, `code`, `error_type` attributes and a detailed `__str__`.

## `ChatPerplexity` changes

- New `use_responses_api: bool | None` field.
- Instance **`_use_responses_api`** respecting the explicit setting, else delegating to the module function.
- **`_to_responses_payload`** — renames `messages`→`input` and `max_tokens`→`max_output_tokens`, drops `temperature`/`top_p`/`top_k`/`metadata`/`stop` (warning only for user-set keys via `user_set_keys`), raises `ValueError` for `tool_choice`, and merges Perplexity-specific keys into `extra_body` (raising `TypeError` if `extra_body` isn't a dict).
- Overridden **`invoke`/`ainvoke`/`stream`/`astream`** that route to dedicated Responses-API helpers (`self.client.responses.create` / async) when `_use_responses_api` is true, otherwise fall through to the existing chat-completions path.
